items.summary:
How to use the BEST astrology placements without having them in your birth chart ⤵️

1.) TIMING WISE ⏰ you can wait for the planets to be in these signs and then take action based on the transits 

✨For example, you might want to get married when Venus is in Libra or Taurus. 

✨Or start your business when Mars is in Capricorn or Scorpio 

✨You might want to put the application on that house when the moon is in Cancer or Taurus. 

✨You might want to launch the podcast when Mercury is in Gemini or Virgo. 

⏰So use the timing and that project or undertaking will forever have that astrological placement in the birth chart of the creation 🙌⚡️

Life hack for ya that will get you far 🥳

2.) Astrological Magic 

🪄 You can use candles, oils, incense and talismans to invoke the planets, ask for support and I’m telling you THEY WORK. I’ve had the most insane results from using oils from (my favs are regulus, asceplius IV and I use exalted mercury oil on the tip of my tongue before I record content) 

Talismans are my favorite way to use astrological magic. I have Alphecca 💎 on my natal ascendent so of COURSE talismans are my fav 🤭 

I recommend getting a talisman from Renaissance Astrology - Christopher Warnock is the best - and start with a planet that is strong in your chart. 

💎 My first talisman was a Mercury talisman (because I have Mercury in Gemini) and I wear it everyday and it has helped me so much in business, sales, marketing, extra energy, content ideas. 

Ready to use these tips in your own life? 

Comment GOLDEN and I’ll send you a link to my free electional astrology class to help you on your Astro journey 🪐
